# 2 Baruch Chapter 60 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**1** "And those black waters which you saw coming after the second bright waters: these are the sins which all the generation of your fathers sinned before the Lord, and they were worse than the sins which the first generation had sinned."

**2** "For they forsook the Most High, and they corrupted his statutes, and they abandoned his ways, and went after the works of their hands, and they served idols; and all these evil things were done by them in the time of their generation."

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the source.*
